definition: Restricted source CSV imported by preprocessing

notes: Contains PHI/PII or restricted clinical data and must not be committed

definition: Generated Stata copy of the imported source CSV

notes: Ignored by git

definition: Generated private analysis dataset consumed by paper and supplemental scripts
derivation_or_transformation: Created by variable cleaning and derivation in preprocessing
notes: Ignored by git

definition: Age used in descriptive tables and models
description: Patient age as analyzed in the cleaned dataset
derivation_or_transformation: Imported then retained; age_decade is derived from this variable
validation_rules: must be nonmissing for included rows
notes: Exact collection timepoint should be confirmed against private source documentation

definition: Age scaled by 10 for regression models
description: Primary age covariate for paper models
derivation_or_transformation: age / 10

definition: Sex after normalization and encoding
derivation_or_transformation: Legacy code recodes male string to M and encodes with binary_label
notes: Exact source values should be confirmed

definition: Post-discharge death indicator
description: Used in survival descriptions and Kaplan-Meier analyses
derivation_or_transformation: Encoded with binary_label

definition: Rib fracture indicator
derivation_or_transformation: Encoded with binary_label

definition: Pneumothorax indicator
derivation_or_transformation: Encoded with binary_label

definition: Chest tube indicator
derivation_or_transformation: Non-N values are recoded to Y before encoding
notes: Legacy broad recode should be reviewed before reuse outside paper replication

definition: Reported injury level before rehabilitation
description: Used to assess reclassification at rehabilitation admission
derivation_or_transformation: Trimmed upper-case string encoded with level_cat
validation_rules: must be valid cervical level code
notes: Code labels do not include C8 in preprocessing

definition: Rehabilitation-assessed cervical injury level
description: Primary injury level measure used in grouping
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed from first split component of ASIA classification
validation_rules: must be valid cervical level code
notes: Supplemental script allows C8 grouping if present

definition: ASIA injury classification at rehabilitation
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed from split ASIA classification and central cord recoded to AIS D
validation_rules: must be consistent with comp_vs_part derivation
notes: Exact numeric code labels should be confirmed in Stata output

definition: Complete motor versus partial motor injury group
derivation_or_transformation: AIS A/B to complete motor; AIS C/D to partial motor
validation_rules: must be 1 or 2 for model rows

definition: High cervical injury group versus low cervical injury group
derivation_or_transformation: C1-C4 to High; C5-C7 to Low
validation_rules: must be 1 or 2 for model rows

readable_name: Initial high versus low cervical injury
definition: Initial pre-rehabilitation high/low injury group
derivation_or_transformation: C1-C4 to High; C5-C7 to Low
validation_rules: must be 1 or 2 when init injury level present

definition: Direction of injury-level change from pre-rehab report to rehab assessment
value_labels: Down lower level | No Change | Up higher level
derivation_or_transformation: Compares numeric encoded initial and rehab injury level
validation_rules: must align with encoded level order

definition: Joint injury level/completeness category
value_labels: 0 = High complete | 1 = High incomplete | 2 = Low complete | 3 = Low incomplete
derivation_or_transformation: Four-level cross-classification

definition: Indicator for partial ventilator wean before rehabilitation admission
description: Used to exclude three paper-analysis rows
derivation_or_transformation: Specific text values for prior-to-rehab daytime wean recoded to Y

definition: Patient achieved daytime ventilator weaning
description: Milestone outcome used in tables and competing-risk analysis
derivation_or_transformation: Source string cleaned and encoded

definition: Days from rehabilitation admission to daytime wean
missing_values: missing when not achieved or source missing
derivation_or_transformation: String timing field cleaned and destringed
notes: Prior-to-rehab values are recoded to 0

definition: Patient achieved 24-hour liberation from invasive mechanical ventilation
description: Milestone outcome used in tables and competing-risk analysis
derivation_or_transformation: Specific N-BiPAP value recoded to N and encoded

definition: Days from rehabilitation admission to 24-hour liberation from IMV
missing_values: missing when not achieved or source missing
derivation_or_transformation: Specific CPAP note recoded to 1 and destringed

definition: Patient achieved tracheostomy decannulation
description: Milestone outcome used in tables and competing-risk analysis
derivation_or_transformation: Source string cleaned and encoded

definition: Days from rehabilitation admission to decannulation
missing_values: missing when not achieved or source missing
derivation_or_transformation: Used directly in paper and supplemental scripts
notes: Original long source variable name retained

definition: Ordinal respiratory outcome at rehabilitation discharge
description: Primary respiratory outcome in proportional-odds model
value_labels: 1 = Fully Vent Dependent | 2 = Weaned During Day | 3 = Liberated from IMV | 4 = Decannulated
derivation_or_transformation: Highest achieved milestone overwrites lower categories
validation_rules: must be ordered from more support to less support

definition: Indicator for transfer from rehabilitation to ICU
derivation_or_transformation: Specific SICU string recoded to Y then encoded

definition: Indicator that ICU transfer was for respiratory cause
derivation_or_transformation: Specific diaphragm pacer placement note recoded to N then encoded

definition: Indicator for pneumonia during rehabilitation
derivation_or_transformation: Cleaned and encoded with binary_label

definition: Ordinal discharge destination at rehabilitation discharge
description: Primary discharge outcome in proportional-odds model
value_labels: 1 = LTAC | 2 = SNF | 3 = Home w/ Home Health | 4 = Home
derivation_or_transformation: Source labels cleaned and encoded with discharge_label
validation_rules: must be ordered from more resource-intensive to less resource-intensive

definition: Binary discharge destination grouping
derivation_or_transformation: LTAC/SNF recoded to facility and home categories recoded to home
validation_rules: must be 1 or 2 when discharge_to present

definition: Indicator for admission from outside hospital
derivation_or_transformation: Cleaned and encoded with binary_label

definition: Calendar date of spinal cord injury
description: Used to derive admission and discharge dates
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed with date(strtrim(dateofinjury)
notes: must parse as date

definition: Derived rehabilitation admission date
description: Used as origin for follow-up calculations
derivation_or_transformation: injury_date + daysfrominjurytoadmissiontorehab
notes: Do not publish row-level dates

definition: Derived rehabilitation discharge date
derivation_or_transformation: injury_date + daysfrominjurytoadmissiontorehab + daystodischargefromrehab
notes: Do not publish row-level dates

definition: Post-discharge death date when present
missing_values: missing for non-deceased or source missing
derivation_or_transformation: Parsed with date(strtrim(tod)
notes: must parse as date when death is 1

readable_name: Follow-up to death or censoring from rehab admission
definition: Days from rehab admission to death or administrative censoring
derivation_or_transformation: date_death - date_admit if death; otherwise 09/30/2023 - date_admit
notes: Administrative censoring date is hard-coded in legacy workflow

readable_name: Follow-up to death or censoring from rehab discharge
definition: Days from rehab discharge to death or administrative censoring
derivation_or_transformation: date_death - date_discharge if death; otherwise 09/30/2023 - date_discharge
notes: Administrative censoring date is hard-coded in legacy workflow
